نستئيل (form X)
# نَسْتَئِيلُ (nastaʔīlu) /nas.ta.ʔiː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
# نَسْتَئِيلَ (nastaʔīla) /nas.ta.ʔiː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
